description: Check a nanomaterial against the EU nanomaterial definition (2022/C 229/01), REACH Annex II (Regulation 2020/878) Safety Data Sheet nanoform requirements and ISO/TR 13014 characterisation coverage. Accepts particle size data (nm), BET surface area, density and optional SDS text.
name: nanoform_reach_check
title: EU REACH nanoform SDS check
